examples.title: ADS1015L DualSupplyMonitor
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. Filtered 3.3 V drives AIN0 and filtered 1.8 V drives AIN2; AIN1/AIN3 are unused; VDD is locally bypassed; ADDR and GND are grounded; SCL/SDA connect to 1.8-V pullups and host endpoints.

evidence.figureCaption: Monitoring Two Supply Voltage Rails Using the ADS1015L
evidence.scope: Figure 9-9 dual-rail monitor, including both 100-ohm/0.47-uF input filters, 3.3-V device rail and 0.1-uF bypass, grounded ADDR/GND, 1.8-V SCL/SDA pullups, bus endpoints, unused analog channels, and relative placement.

examples.title: ADS7042 DirectSensorInterface
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. Sensor+ -> ROUT -> AINP; CFLT spans AINP to AINM; Sensor- drives AINM and ground; AVDD, DVDD, GND, SCLK, SDO, and CS are exposed as labeled reusable endpoints.

evidence.figureCaption: Interfacing the Device Directly with Sensors
evidence.scope: Exact analog interface shown by TI: differential sensor endpoints, ROUT in series with AINP, CFLT across AINP/AINM, and source-relative placement. Device power and SPI endpoints are additionally exposed outside that figure-specific analog scope to make the block reusable.

examples.title: BQ25185 TypicalBatteryCharger
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VBUS and CIN feed IN; STAT1/STAT2/CE connect to the host block; ILIM/VSET and ISET use their TI resistors; SYS feeds CSYS and the regulated load; BAT feeds CBAT and the cell; TS/MR feeds the NTC and pushbutton; all returns share GND.

evidence.scope: Recreates the external application connectivity and placement in Figure 8-1: VBUS/CIN, host status and CE lines, 5-kohm ILIM/VSET, 1-kohm ISET, SYS load/CSYS, BAT/CBAT/battery, TS/MR pushbutton, and NTC.

examples.title: CC2340R5MODA TypicalApplication
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. CA1/Z60-Z62 form the internal-antenna matching path to ANT_IN; optional CA2 selects the external coax path to RFIO; Y1 with R2/R3/C5/C6 forms the 32.768-kHz network; R4/C7 form the active-low reset branch; VDDS and all ground pads share their named rails.

evidence.scope: Figure 9-1 module-centered implementation of the internal/external antenna selection and Z60-Z62 matching area, optional RF connector path, 32.768-kHz crystal network, reset RC, VDDS rails, and common ground pads. General-purpose DIO destinations beyond the figure labels remain exposed.

examples.title: DRV8833 ParallelMotorDriver
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. IN1 drives AIN1 and BIN1; IN2 drives AIN2 and BIN2; AOUT1/BOUT1 share one motor terminal and AOUT2/BOUT2 share the other; VM feeds C4 and C1 while C1 returns to VCP; VINT uses C2; AISEN/BISEN share R2; U1.GND and passive returns share GND.

evidence.scope: Recreates Figure 7's parallel-mode controller inputs, paired A/B bridge outputs into one brushed motor, VM/C4/C1/VCP network, VINT/C2, combined AISEN/BISEN with 0.2-ohm R2, nSLEEP control, nFAULT stub, and ground.

examples.title: INA138 BasicCurrentSense
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VP -> RS -> load; U1 IN+ and IN- Kelvin-connect across RS; U1 is powered from V+; U1 OUT drives both VO and RL to ground.

evidence.scope: Full external Figure 9 high-side current-sense topology and relative placement, including RS, load, independent V+, RL, VO, and all ground returns.

examples.title: INA181 BidirectionalCurrentSense
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. The bus drives RSENSE and load; U1 IN+ and IN- span RSENSE; VS powers and bypasses U1; OUT is exposed; a divider-derived, unity-buffered reference drives REF.

evidence.scope: Figure 8-7 bus/shunt/load path, INA181 supply and bypass, output, selectable reference divider and buffer, feedback, grounds, and relative left-to-right placement.

examples.title: LM358B Inverting-Amplifier Application
examples.description: A hand-authored schematic rendering of TI's inverting-amplifier application using the worked-example RI and RF values.

evidence.scope: Figure 8-1 inverting-amplifier topology and placement with section 8.2.2 worked values RI=10 kohm and RF=36 kohm.

examples.title: LMC555 Monostable LED Flasher
examples.description: A reusable rendering of TI's monostable LED-flasher circuit, preserving the reference switch, LED, timing network, control capacitor, and relative placement.

evidence.figureCaption: Schematic of Monostable Mode to Flash an LED
evidence.scope: Complete Figure 8-1 topology and placement, including both 10-kohm resistors, the 470-ohm LED resistor, 470-uF timing capacitor, and 0.01-uF control capacitor shown in the figure.

examples.title: LMK1C1104 ClockFanout
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. A labeled 100-MHz LVCMOS oscillator U5 drives CLKIN; R4 pulls enable 1G high; Y0/Y1 feed CPU and FPGA clocks through source resistors; Y3 feeds the PLL reference with TI's 100-ohm Thevenin termination.

evidence.scope: Figure 10-1 100-MHz LVCMOS source, active-high enable, two CMOS receiver branches, and one Thevenin-terminated PLL-reference branch. Generic Yn is mapped to Y3 on LMK1C1104; unused Y2 is outside scope.

examples.title: LMT70 AnalogTemperatureToAdc
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. The supply drives LMT70 VDD and T_ON and the MCU VDD endpoint; LMT70 TAO drives the MCU ADC endpoint; a separate 1.5-V rail drives the MCU VREF endpoint; LMT70 GND is grounded.

evidence.scope: Complete LMT70 side of TI's typical application: 2.2-V to 3.6-V supply shared by VDD and T_ON, TAO to the MSP430 ADC endpoint, ground, and the separate 1.5-V MSP430 reference endpoint with source-relative placement.

examples.title: MSPM0C1103 AdcInputNetwork
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. Vin passes through parasitic Rpar/R1, with Cpar/C1 shunting the intermediate node to ground, then through Rin/R2 to U1.PA0. The U1 symbol reproduces TI's CI, S1, CS/H and 12-bit SAR equivalent model.

evidence.scope: Complete Figure 7-2 ADC input equivalent network: external Rpar/Cpar and Rin feeding PA0, plus the internal CI, S1, CS/H, and 12-bit SAR representation. Numerical external R/C values are illustrative because TI directs the designer to device characteristics and the external ADC-input circuit.

examples.title: OPA320 SecondOrderLowPassFilter
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VIN -> R1 -> R2 -> U1 IN-; C1 shunts the R1/R2 node to ground; R3 returns OUT to the R1/R2 node; C2 returns OUT to U1 IN-; U1 IN+ is grounded; OUT is exposed as VOUT.

evidence.scope: External Figure 45 signal path, all five passive values, op-amp polarity/orientation, feedback branches, rails, and relative placement. The physical OPA320S shutdown input is tied to V+ electrically but intentionally omitted from the visible signal-path drawing, as in TI's figure.

examples.title: OPA333 ThermistorBridge
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. The left bridge midpoint drives U1 IN+; the 60-kohm/NTC midpoint drives U1 IN-; 100-kohm RF returns VOUT to IN-; bridge and op-amp share 3 V and ground.

evidence.scope: Complete TI temperature-measurement bridge: two 1-Mohm arms, 60-kohm arm, NTC thermistor arm, 100-kohm feedback, 3-V excitation, op-amp polarity/orientation, and relative placement.

examples.title: OPA371D Low-Side Current-Sense Reference
examples.description: A faithful schematic rendering of the OPAx371D low-side current-sensing application, preserving TI's stated values, topology, and left-to-right placement.

evidence.scope: Complete Figure 7-1 signal path and feedback network; ZLOAD remains symbolic because TI does not specify its impedance.

traces.evidenceLabel: ZLOAD/RSHUNT junction drives the noninverting input
amplifier output is VOUT and feeds RF
RF/RG gain divider feeds the inverting input
device negative supply returns to ground

examples.title: SN65HVD3082E MultipointRS485Network
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. Four transceivers share RS485_A/RS485_B; U1 and U2 are the two end nodes with 120-ohm R1/R2 termination, while U3 and U4 are unterminated midpoint drops.

evidence.scope: Complete Figure 9-2 four-node differential-bus topology and relative placement: two terminated end nodes and two short unterminated midpoint drops. The logic-side R, nRE, DE, and D pins remain exposed, matching the figure.

examples.title: SN74AHC1G14 SwitchDebouncer
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VCC pull-up R1 and grounded pushbutton SW1 share the U1.A debounce node; the inverting Schmitt output U1.Y drives MCU.GPIO_IN.

evidence.scope: Complete Figure 8-1 external signal topology and relative placement: grounded physical pushbutton, VCC pull-up, inverting Schmitt trigger, and symbolic microprocessor input. Package supply pins are outside the figure's implemented scope.

examples.title: SN74AUP1G17 TurnOnPulseGenerator
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. R1 pulls the timing node to VCC, C1 returns it to GND, the timing node drives U1.A, and U1.Y is exposed as VO.

evidence.figureCaption: Figure 8. SN74AUP1G17 Turn-On Pulse Generator (Normally High Output)
evidence.scope: Complete Figure 8 external RC timing topology and relative placement through the non-inverting Schmitt buffer to VO. TI does not label numerical R or C values in the figure, so 100 kohm and 100 nF are illustrative placeholders.

examples.title: TCAN1044A 5VCanInterface
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. Generic 5-V regulator U2 powers CAN-FD MCU U3 and transceiver U1; TXD/RXD/STB connect between U3 and U1; CANH/CANL feed optional split R1/R2/C4 termination and D1/D2 ESD branches.

evidence.figureCaption: Figure 9-1 TCAN1044A-Q1 Transceiver Application Using 5V IO Connections
evidence.scope: Figure 9-1 regulator-to-MCU-to-transceiver signal and supply topology, including the optional split-termination and ESD branches. The regulator and MCU are symbolic functional blocks; unlabeled bypass, filter, and ESD values use explicit example placeholders.

examples.title: TLV755P TypicalApplication
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. DC/DC output feeds U1.IN and CIN; U1.OUT feeds COUT and the load; U1.GND, CIN, COUT, converter return, and load return share GND; U1.EN is shown with the TI ON/OFF switch geometry.

evidence.scope: Recreates Figure 7-4 from the DC/DC-converter source through the 1-uF input capacitor, TLV755P enable switch, 1-uF output capacitor, shared return, and load block; device operating curves and PCB layout are out of scope.

examples.title: TMP102 TwoWireTemperatureSensor
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. SCL, SDA, and ALERT each connect to a host endpoint and a 5-kohm supply pullup; V+ is bypassed with 0.01 uF; ADD0 and GND are grounded.

evidence.scope: All Figure 7-1 external connections and values: 1.4-V to 3.6-V supply, three 5-kohm pullups, 0.01-uF bypass, SCL/SDA/ALERT host endpoints, ADD0 grounding, device grounding, and relative placement.

examples.title: TPS22919 LoadSwitchTypicalApplication
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VIN source and CIN feed U1.IN; U1.OUT feeds CL and RL; U1.QOD returns through RQOD; the source, capacitors, load, and U1.GND share GND; U1.ON uses the H/L switch shown by TI.

evidence.scope: Recreates Figure 30 with the 3.3-V source, CIN, H/L ON control, TPS22919, QOD resistor, CL, and RL; transient plots and layout guidance are out of scope.

examples.title: TPS61165 WhiteLedDriver
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VIN feeds C1, U1.VIN, and L1; the L1/D1 boost path feeds C2 and the LED string; the LED-string return feeds U1.FB and Rset; U1.COMP uses 220 nF; U1.CTRL is the dimming input; GND and EP return to GND.

evidence.scope: Recreates the front-page typical application with 5-V input, C1, 10-uH L1, D1, C2, three series white LEDs, 0.57-ohm Rset, 220-nF COMP capacitor, CTRL input, and both ground returns.

examples.title: TPS61299 5VBoostConverter
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VIN feeds CIN, U1.VIN, and L1; L1 feeds U1.SW; U1.VOUT and VSEL share the output node with COUT; U1.GND and both capacitors return to GND; EN is drawn with TI's ON/OFF switch.

evidence.figureCaption: 3.6-V Input Source to 5-V Boost Converter Under Fast Mode
evidence.scope: Recreates Figure 8-1's 1-uH boost path, 10-uF input/output capacitors, VSEL-to-output strap, enable switch, and 5-V output; performance plots are out of scope.

examples.title: TPS62A01 1V8BuckConverter
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. VIN feeds U1.VIN, U1.EN, CIN, and R4; U1.SW feeds L1 and the VOUT rail; R1/R2/C3 form the FB network; R4 pulls up PG to VIN and exposes VPG; CIN, C2, R2, and U1.GND return to GND.

evidence.scope: Recreates Figure 8-1 for the 1.8-V/1-A option, including CIN, L1, R1/R2 feedback divider, C3 feed-forward capacitor, C2, EN-to-VIN strap, and R4/VPG branch.

examples.title: TPS7A20 Typical Application
examples.description: A hand-authored schematic rendering of TI's fixed 2.8 V TPS7A20 typical application with the specified 1 uF input and output capacitors.

evidence.scope: Complete Figure 7-4 topology and placement using the fixed 2.8 V device and Table 7-1 capacitor values.

examples.title: TPS92612 LinearLedDriver
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. The supply rail feeds CSUPPLY, U1.SUPPLY, and RSNS; RSNS feeds U1.IN; U1.OUT drives the series LED string; COUT spans OUT to the LED-string ground; U1.GND and CSUPPLY return to GND; PWM is exposed at U1.PWM.

evidence.scope: Recreates the front-page typical application with the 4.5-V-to-40-V rail, supply capacitor, PWM input, high-side R(SNS), C(OUT), and three-LED string to ground.

examples.title: TRS3232E TypicalOperatingCircuit
examples.description: Reusable TI-reference block. C1 and C2 are the two charge-pump flying capacitors; C3 and C4 are the V+/V- reservoirs to ground; C5 bypasses VCC; both RS-232 channels remain exposed as in the TI operating figure.

evidence.figureCaption: Figure 8-1 TRS3232E Typical Operating Circuit and Capacitor Values
evidence.scope: Complete Figure 8-1 external charge-pump and bypass-capacitor topology with both RS-232 channels exposed. Capacitors use the 0.1-uF values specified by Figure 8-1/Table 8-1 for a 3.3-V supply.
